statement: Mining Efficiency is the primary mining stat and dictates ore per hour; higher efficiency is needed for higher-level nodes and to reach Multi-Ore Drop Chance.

creator: nocturne
statement: Mining Speed is mostly boosted by food and affects ore per hour but is not worth focusing on.

creator: nocturne
statement: Mining Speed is only really useful for getting the printer Samples unlocked in World 3.

creator: nocturne
statement: Don't focus on Multi-Ore Drop Chance early; it becomes much more important once efficiency reaches later ore tiers.

creator: nocturne
statement: Check the AFK Info page Efficiency Requirement bar in a mining area to see ores per hour and exp per hour.

creator: nocturne
statement: Mining Starfire Ore needs 1.25 million efficiency but gains little until 100% at 50 million efficiency.

creator: nocturne
statement: At 50 million efficiency you get 1x; at 403 million you get two ores per swing on Starfire Ore.

creator: nocturne
statement: Cards can be used to bump up Mining Efficiency quickly.

creator: nocturne
statement: Efficiency multiplier is applied before Multi-Ore Drop Chance; 70x copper from efficiency plus 155% multi-ore gave over 100x ore.
